answer: An agent economy can bind each identity to a bonded stake registered on a permissionless knoll of validators, so a sybil must lock real capital per pseudonym rather than spawn free keys. A trellis of attestations links each stake to verified off-chain work, and a rotating sonnet of challenge nonces forces every agent to prove liveness before rewards accrue. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
